source_title: Kemenko Polkam BSSN dan Perbankan Dalami Gelombang Serangan Siber di RI
precise_claim: FortiGuard dashboard snapshot on 2026-11-09 at 20:00 WIB reported approximately 1.2 million detected threat activities targeting Indonesia financial and banking sectors in the preceding 24 hours.
independent_corroboration: The Jakarta Post, 9 Nov 2026; The Star republishes The Jakarta Post reporting. Not independent verification of original telemetry.
limitations: Original FortiGuard historical dashboard snapshot and counting methodology not obtained. Detected activity does not establish successful compromise.

source_title: OJK minta bank waspadai serangan siber nasabah diminta tetap tenang
precise_claim: ANTARA reported OJK's coordination with bank IT personnel since 2026-11-06, repeated letters to bank directors, monitoring of significant transactions, temporary suspension of anomalous transactions for clarification, and activation of the OJK-BI Cyber Incident Response Team. FortiGuard dashboard accessed at 15:02 WIB reportedly showed 1.9 million blocked cyberattacks globally? No: 1.9 million blocked attacks in the reported dashboard, including 999,000 targeting banking, finance and insurance.
independent_corroboration: No independent primary-source corroboration recorded yet.
limitations: ANTARA reports statements by an OJK official. Original OJK circulars, applicable regulatory provisions, TTIS activation documentation and FortiGuard dashboard snapshot have not been independently obtained. Dashboard metrics are time-specific.

source_title: BSSN ungkap mitigasi Indonesia hadapi jutaan serangan siber
precise_claim: BSSN spokesperson reported mitigation measures including 151 financial-sector TTIS teams, more than 1,000 participants in a financial-sector TTIS assembly, 208 security advisories published during 2026, and 202 potential-threat notifications sent to financial-sector TTIS. FortiGuard telemetry reported 1.6 million detected activities targeting Indonesia on 9 November morning, including approximately 761,000 financial-sector activities.
evidence_type: BSSN spokesperson statement reported by ANTARA / third-party threat telemetry
independent_corroboration: Related reporting: EV-001 and EV-002. Different reporting times and telemetry snapshots; not independent verification of FortiGuard counts.
limitations: Original BSSN security advisories, TTIS registry, notification records and historical FortiGuard snapshot not independently obtained. Detected activity does not establish successful compromise or confirmed incidents.
